exercises.instructionEn: The Shark Caller - Episode 1: The Curse
exercises.explanationUz:
KOMIKS - HIKOYaNING BIRINChI QISMI.

  ⚠ Kitobda uchta hikoya bor, har biri
  ikki qismdan (uchinchisidan tashqari).
  Ular har uch-to'rt unitdan keyin
  keladi.

  ⚠ Hikoya - DAM OLISh emas: har biri
  bitta grammatika mavzusini
  mustahkamlaydi. Bu qismning mavzusi:
  ANIQLIK bildirish (must, can't, will).


QAHRAMONLAR:

  Mike   - 'The Morning Sun' gazetasining
           MUHARRIRI
  Sandra - muxbir (sariq sochli)
  David  - muxbir (qora sochli)
  Senan  - 'akula chaqiruvchi'
  Mosan  - Senanning raqibi


JOY: Kontu qishlog'i, Janubiy Tinch
okeani.


⚠ 'THE SHARK CALLER':

  = akula chaqiruvchi.
  ⚠ 'to call' (chaqirmoq) → 'a caller'.

  ⚠ Bu - HAQIQIY an'ana: Papua Yangi
  Gvineyaning ba'zi qishloqlarida
  akula chaqiruvchilar bo'lgan.


⚠ 'A CURSE':

  = la'nat.
  ⚠ 'to curse sb' = kimnidir la'natlamoq.
  ⚠ Mosan 7-kadrda aynan shuni qiladi:
  'I CURSE you, Senan!'


⚠ MATNDAGI 'MUST' VA 'CAN'T':

  'Senan MUST be the one on the left.'
     = chap tomondagi Senan bo'lsa kerak
  "No, it CAN'T be him."
     = yo'q, u bo'lishi mumkin emas
  'Senan MUST be the older man.'
     = Senan kattaroq odam bo'lsa kerak

  ⚠ Bu yerda 'must' MAJBURIYaT EMAS,
  TAXMIN bildiradi (25-betdagi quti).


⚠ 'YOU MUST PREPARE' - BOShQA MA'NO:

  'Now you MUST prepare for tomorrow.'
  ⚠ Bu esa HAQIQIY MAJBURIYaT.

  ⚠ Ya'ni bitta hikoyada 'must' ning
  IKKI ma'nosi ham bor - ataylab.


⚠ "IT'LL ATTACK US":

  = u bizga hujum qiladi.
  ⚠ "it'll" = 'it will' - KELAJAK haqida
  taxmin (25-betdagi 'Will' qutisi).

tasks.en: The Shark Caller - Episode 1: The Curse
tasks.uz: Akula chaqiruvchi - 1-qism: La'nat

tasks.en: Mike, the editor of The Morning Sun, has sent Sandra and David to the village of Kontu in the South Pacific.
tasks.uz: 'The Morning Sun' gazetasining muharriri Mayk Sandra va Devidni Janubiy Tinch okeanidagi Kontu qishlog'iga jo'natdi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'an editor' = muharrir.
⚠ 'has sent' - PRESENT PERFECT: yubordi va
ular hozir o'sha yerda.
⚠ 'the South Pacific' - 'the' bilan.

tasks.en: They are going to investigate the story of a man, Senan, who has the power to call sharks.
tasks.uz: Ular akulalarni chaqirish qudratiga ega Senan ismli odamning hikoyasini o'rganmoqchi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'be going to' = niyat (5-unit mavzusi).
⚠ 'to investigate' = tekshirmoq, o'rganmoq.
⚠ 'the power TO DO sth' - otdan keyin INFINITIV.

tasks.en: So, this is the village of Kontu. Let's find Senan now.
tasks.uz: Xo'sh, bu Kontu qishlog'i. Endi Senanni topaylik.
tasks.note:
⚠ "Let's" = 'let us' - taklif.
⚠ Keyin ODDIY fe'l: "Let's FIND" ('to find' EMAS).

tasks.en: Look at those two men. Senan must be the one on the left.
tasks.uz: Anavi ikki erkakka qarang. Senan chap tomondagisi bo'lsa kerak.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'must' bu yerda TAXMIN: 'bo'lsa kerak'.
⚠ 'the one' = o'sha kishi (takrorlamaslik uchun).
⚠ 'ON the left' - predlog 'on'.

tasks.en: No, it can't be him. He's too young. Senan must be the older man. Look, he's coming over.
tasks.uz: Yo'q, u bo'lishi mumkin emas. U juda yosh. Senan kattaroq odam bo'lsa kerak. Qara, u bu yoqqa kelyapti.
tasks.note:
⚠ "can't be" - TAXMINNING INKORI:
'bo'lishi mumkin emas'.
⚠ 'too young' = juda yosh (haddan tashqari).
⚠ 'to come over' = yaqinlashmoq.

tasks.en: His eyes look like a shark's, and he's got marks on his arms and legs.
tasks.uz: Uning ko'zlari akulanikiga o'xshaydi va qo'l-oyog'ida belgilar bor.
tasks.note:
⚠ "a shark's" = "a shark's eyes" - takroriy ot
TUShIRIB QOLDIRILGAN.
⚠ 'to look like' = ... ga o'xshamoq.
⚠ 'a mark' = belgi, iz.

tasks.en: Hello, Sandra. Hello, David. Come. My hut is this way.
tasks.uz: Salom, Sandra. Salom, Devid. Yuringlar. Kulbam bu tomonda.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'a hut' = kulba (5-mashqda ham bor).
⚠ 'this way' = bu tomonda, bu yoqda.

tasks.en: How do you know who we are?
tasks.uz: Bizning kimligimizni qanday bilasiz?
tasks.note:
⚠ 'who we are' - O'ZLAShTIRMA SO'ROQ:
so'z tartibi ODDIY GAPDAGIDEK ('who are we' EMAS).
⚠ Bu 14-unitning grammatika mavzusi.

tasks.en: I dreamt about you. Now you must prepare for tomorrow. You must eat only sweet potatoes and go to sleep early tonight.
tasks.uz: Men sizlarni tush ko'rdim. Endi ertangi kunga tayyorgarlik ko'rishing kerak. Faqat shirin kartoshka yeb, bugun erta uxlashing kerak.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'dreamt' - Britaniya shakli ('dreamed' - AQSh).
⚠ 'to dream ABOUT sb' - predlog 'about'.
⚠ Bu yerda 'must' HAQIQIY MAJBURIYaT - oldingi
'must' lardan FARQ QILADI.

tasks.en: But what is all this for?
tasks.uz: Lekin bularning hammasi nima uchun?
tasks.note:
⚠ 'What ... FOR?' = nima uchun?
⚠ 'for' HAR DOIM oxirida qoladi.
⚠ 'Why?' bilan bir xil ma'no, lekin
so'zlashuvda ko'proq ishlatiladi.

tasks.en: Don't ask questions. Do as I say. I'm going to the forest to begin my magic and dream of the shark.
tasks.uz: Savol bermang. Men aytganday qiling. Men o'rmonga sehrimni boshlash va akulani tush ko'rish uchun ketyapman.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to ASK questions' - 'to do' EMAS.
⚠ 'Do as I say' = men aytganday qiling.
⚠ 'to dream OF' - 'about' bilan ham bo'ladi.

tasks.en: Heeya, Heeya ...
tasks.uz: Xeyya, Xeyya ...
tasks.note:
⚠ Bu - so'z emas, SEHRLI qichqiriq.
⚠ Komikslarda tovushni yozish uchun bunday
shakl ishlatiladi.

tasks.en: NEXT MORNING ON THE SHORE - I curse you, Senan! I command the skies to bring rain!
tasks.uz: ERTASI KUNI ERTALAB QIRG'OQDA - Seni la'natlayman, Senan! Osmonga yomg'ir yog'dirishni buyuraman!
tasks.note:
⚠ 'a shore' = qirg'oq (dengiz).
⚠ 'to curse' = la'natlamoq - QISM NOMI shu
so'zdan.
⚠ 'to command sb TO DO sth' - infinitiv bilan.
⚠ 'the skies' - she'riy shakl ('the sky' o'rniga).

tasks.en: Who's that man? He looked very angry!
tasks.uz: Anavi odam kim? U juda jahli chiqqanga o'xshardi!
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to look angry' = jahli chiqqanga o'xshamoq
(5-mashqda ham bor).
⚠ 'looked' - PAST SIMPLE.

tasks.en: He's Mosan. He's jealous of me. Now, get ready. The shark is near us.
tasks.uz: U Mosan. U menga hasad qiladi. Endi tayyorlaning. Akula yaqinimizda.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'jealous OF sb' - predlog 'of'
(8-betdagi 14-mashqda ham bor edi).
⚠ 'to get ready' = tayyorlanmoq (5-mashqda).
⚠ 'near' - predlogsiz: 'near us'.

tasks.en: Sandra, look! He's beating the water with coconut shells.
tasks.uz: Sandra, qara! U suvni kokos qobiqlari bilan urmoqda.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to beat' = urmoq (beat - beat - beaten).
⚠ 'a shell' = qobiq.
⚠ 'WITH' - qurol/vosita predlogi.

tasks.en: It is magic. It worked! There are shark fins over there ... Oh, no! A shark is under the canoe! It'll attack us! David, do something!
tasks.uz: Bu sehr. Ishladi! Anavi yerda akula qanotlari ko'rinyapti ... Voy! Qayiq ostida akula bor! U bizga hujum qiladi! Devid, biror narsa qil!
tasks.note:
⚠ 'It IS magic' - 'is' TA'KIDLANGAN
(qiya harfda berilgan).
⚠ 'a fin' = suzgich, qanot (baliqniki).
⚠ "it'll attack" = 'it will' - KELAJAK haqida
taxmin (25-betdagi 'Will' qutisi).
⚠ 'a canoe' = qayiq; /kəˈnuː/ deb o'qiladi.

exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarga qarang, so'ng gaplarni o'qing va to'g'ri variantni aylantiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBLAR KOMIKSDA BOR.

  ⚠ Har savol bitta kadrga tegishli -
  rasmga va gap pufakchasiga qarang.


⚠ 'A VILLAGE', 'A TOWN', 'A CITY':

  a village - qishloq (eng kichik)
  a town    - shaharcha
  a city    - katta shahar

  ⚠ Kirish matnida aynan 'the VILLAGE
  of Kontu' deyilgan.


⚠ 'A HUT', 'A FLAT', 'A COTTAGE':

  a hut     - kulba (oddiy, somon yoki
              yog'ochdan)
  a flat    - kvartira
  a cottage - qishloqdagi kichik uy
              (mustahkam, g'ishtdan)

  ⚠ Senan 3-kadrda: 'My HUT is this way.'


⚠ 'A BOWL OF ...':

  = bir kosa ...
  ⚠ 4-kadrda idishda ovqat ko'rinadi.
  Senan aytadi: 'You must eat only
  SWEET POTATOES.'

tasks.whyUz:
⚠ Kirish matnida: 'the VILLAGE of Kontu in the
South Pacific'.
⚠ 1-kadrda somon tomli kulbalar va dengiz
ko'rinadi.
⚠ 'BY the sea' = dengiz bo'yida.

⚠ Kirish matnida: 'the story of A MAN, Senan'.
⚠ 'to look FOR' = qidirmoq (predlog 'for').

tasks.prompt: 3  The man takes them to his ___ .
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ 3-kadrda Senan aytadi: 'My HUT is this way.'
⚠ 'a hut' = somon yoki yog'och kulba.

tasks.prompt: 4  The man gives them a bowl of ___ .
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ 4-kadrda Senan aytadi: 'You must eat only
SWEET POTATOES.'
⚠ 'a bowl of' = bir kosa.

tasks.prompt: 5  The man beats the water with coconut ___ .
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ Oxirgi kadrda: 'He's beating the water with
coconut SHELLS.'
⚠ 'a shell' = qobiq.

exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarga qarang, so'ng savollarga javob bering. Sandra uchun S, Devid uchun D, Senan uchun Se yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
RASMDAGI UCh QAHRAMON:

  SANDRA - sariq (fair) uzun sochli,
     yashil ko'zli ayol
  DAVID  - qora, kalta, tekis sochli
     erkak
  SENAN  - to'q tanli, ajinli qora tanli
     erkak


⚠ TAShQI QIYoFA SO'ZLARI - 6 va
8-BETLARDAN:

  fair hair - oq-sariq soch
  a dark complexion - to'q yuz rangi
  straight hair - tekis soch
  wrinkles - ajinlar

  ⚠ Bu so'zlar 1-unitning 12-mashqidagi
  jadvalda o'rganilgan edi - bu yerda
  ular QAYTA ishlatilyapti.


⚠ "WHO'S GOT ...?":

  = kimning ... bor?
  ⚠ To'liq: 'Who HAS got ...?'
  ⚠ Britaniya egaligi ('have got').

  ⚠ Javob: 'Sandra has' yoki qisqa
  belgi bilan 'S'.

tasks.prompt: 4  Who's got short straight black hair?

exercises.instructionEn: Listen and write S for Sandra, D for David or Se for Senan.
exercises.instructionUz: Tinglang va Sandra uchun S, Devid uchun D, Senan uchun Se yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBLAR KOMIKSDA BOR.

  ⚠ Kassetada shu epizod o'qiladi -
  mashqni AUDIOSIZ ham bajarish mumkin:
  har gapning qaysi pufakchada
  ekanini toping.


⚠ QAYSI GAP KIMNIKI:

  1  "No, it can't be him." - 2-kadrdagi
     SANDRA ning pufakchasi
  2  "He's got marks on his arms." -
     2-kadrdagi DAVID ning pufakchasi
  3  'You must prepare for tomorrow.' -
     4-kadrdagi SENAN ning pufakchasi
  4  'But what is all this for?' -
     5-kadrdagi SANDRA ning pufakchasi
  5  'There are shark fins over there.' -
     oxirgi kadrdagi SANDRA ning
     pufakchasi

  ⚠ Sandra UCh marta, David va Senan
  bir martadan gapiradi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the episode and answer the questions.
exercises.instructionUz: Epizodni o'qing va savollarga javob bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ GAP BILAN JAVOB BERISh.

  ⚠ Har javob komiksdagi ANIQ gapga
  asoslanadi.


⚠ 'EXACTLY':

  'Where EXACTLY are they?'
  = ular aynan qayerda?
  ⚠ 'exactly' savolni ANIQROQ qiladi:
  'Osiyoda' emas, 'Kontu qishlog'ida'
  degan javob kutiladi.


⚠ 'WHY' SAVOLIGA JAVOB:

  'Why does Senan go to the forest?'
  → 'To begin his magic and dream of
     the shark.'

  ⚠ MAQSAD uchun INFINITIV ('to' + fe'l)
  ishlatiladi - 'for begin' XATO.
  ⚠ 'Because he wants to ...' ham to'g'ri.

tasks.answer: Where exactly are David and Sandra?
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ Kirish matnidan.
⚠ 'exactly' - aniq joy nomi kutiladi.
tasks.speakAnswer: Where exactly are David and Sandra?

⚠ 4-kadrdagi buyruqlar.
tasks.speakAnswer: He asks them to eat only sweet potatoes and go to sleep early.

tasks.answer: Why does Senan go to the forest?
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ MAQSAD uchun INFINITIV: 'TO begin'.
⚠ 5-kadrda Senanning gapidan.
tasks.speakAnswer: Why does Senan go to the forest?

⚠ MAQSAD uchun INFINITIV: 'TO begin'.
⚠ 5-kadrda Senanning gapidan.
tasks.speakAnswer: To begin his magic and dream of the shark.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the words from the list, then make sentences using the completed phrases.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdagi so'zlarni qo'ying, so'ng tayyor iboralar bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
HAMMA IBORA KOMIKSDA BOR.


TO'LIQ RO'YXAT:

  to CALL sharks    - akula chaqirmoq
  SWEET potatoes    - shirin kartoshka
  to GO to sleep    - uxlagani yotmoq
  to ASK questions  - savol bermoq
  to LOOK angry     - jahli chiqqanga
                      o'xshamoq
  to GET ready      - tayyorlanmoq
  COCONUT shells    - kokos qobiqlari
  SHARK fins        - akula qanotlari


⚠ 'TO GO TO SLEEP' va 'TO GO TO BED':

  go to bed = to'shakka yotmoq
  go to sleep = UXLAB QOLMOQ

  ⚠ Ikkalasi ham ARTIKLSIZ.


⚠ 'TO LOOK' + SIFAT:

  'to look angry' = jahli chiqqanga
     o'xshamoq
  ⚠ 'look' dan keyin SIFAT keladi,
  ravish EMAS: 'look angry'
  ('look angrily' - boshqa ma'no).

  ⚠ Xuddi shunday: 'look tired',
  'look happy', 'sound interesting',
  'feel cold'.


⚠ 'TO ASK QUESTIONS':

  ⚠ 'to MAKE questions' - XATO.
  ⚠ 'to ask A question' (birlik) yoki
  'to ask questions' (ko'plik).

KITOBDAGI QUTI.

  'We use MUST + infinitive WITHOUT TO
   to say that something is logically
   true.'
     'This MUST BE her bag. Her purse is
      inside it.'
     (= I'm sure the bag is hers.)

  'We use CAN'T + infinitive WITHOUT TO
   to say that something is logically
   untrue.'
     'The Rover CAN'T BE his. He's got a
      Lancia.'
     (= I'm sure the Rover isn't his.)


⚠ ENG MUHIM: 'MUST' NING IKKI MA'NOSI

  1) MAJBURIYaT:
     'You must eat only sweet potatoes.'
     = yeyishing KERAK

  2) TAXMIN (aniqlik):
     'Senan must be the older man.'
     = u bo'lsa KERAK

  ⚠ Farqi KONTEKSTdan bilinadi.
  ⚠ Taxmin ma'nosida odatda 'be' fe'li
  bilan keladi: 'must BE'.


⚠ 'CAN'T' - TAXMINNING INKORI:

  ⚠ DIQQAT: taxminni inkor qilish uchun
  'MUSTN'T' EMAS, 'CAN'T' ishlatiladi!

  'It must be him.' (u bo'lsa kerak)
  "It can't be him." (u bo'lishi mumkin
     emas)

  ⚠ "mustn't" = TAQIQ: 'You mustn't
  smoke here.' (chekish MUMKIN EMAS)


⚠ IShONCh DARAJASI:

  must be  - 95% ishonch (ha)
  might be - 50% (balki)
  can't be - 95% ishonch (yo'q)

  ⚠ 'might' 10-unitda o'rganiladi.


⚠ 'INFINITIVE WITHOUT TO':

  = 'to' siz infinitiv.
  ⚠ HAMMA modal fe'ldan keyin shunday:
     must be, can't be, will be,
     should go, might come
  ⚠ 'must to be' - XATO.


=== 'WILL' QUTISI ===

  'We use WILL + infinitive without to
   to make predictions based on what we
   believe or think. We usually use
   WILL with I think, I expect,
   probably etc.'
     'I think it WILL rain today.'

  ⚠ 'will' - TAXMINIY kelajak
  (dalilsiz, fikrga asoslangan).

  ⚠ 'be going to' esa DALILGA
  asoslangan: 'Look at those clouds -
  it's going to rain.'

  ⚠ Bu farq 5-unitda batafsil
  o'rganiladi.


⚠ 'WILL' BILAN KELADIGAN SO'ZLAR:

  I think ... will ...
  I expect ... will ...
  ... will probably ...
  I'm sure ... will ...
  Perhaps ... will ...
exercises.bookRef: Coursebook, 25-bet, Expressing Certainty va Will qutilari

tasks.en: Expressing Certainty
tasks.uz: Aniqlik bildirish

tasks.en: We use must + infinitive without to to say that something is logically true.
tasks.uz: Biror narsa mantiqan to'g'ri ekanini aytish uchun 'must' + 'to' siz infinitiv ishlatamiz.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'infinitive without to' = 'to' siz fe'l.
⚠ 'must to be' - XATO.

tasks.en: This must be her bag. Her purse is inside it. (= I'm sure the bag is hers.)
tasks.uz: Bu uning sumkasi bo'lsa kerak. Hamyoni ichida. (= Sumka uniki ekaniga ishonchim komil.)
tasks.note:
⚠ 'must be' - 95% ishonch.
⚠ 'hers' - EGALIK olmoshi ('her bag' = 'hers').
⚠ 'a purse' - 20-betdagi 16-mashqda ham bor edi.

tasks.en: We use can't + infinitive without to to say that something is logically untrue.
tasks.uz: Biror narsa mantiqan noto'g'ri ekanini aytish uchun "can't" + 'to' siz infinitiv ishlatamiz.
tasks.note:
⚠ DIQQAT: "mustn't" EMAS, "CAN'T"!
⚠ "mustn't" = TAQIQ, taxminning inkori emas.

tasks.en: The Rover can't be his. He's got a Lancia. (= I'm sure the Rover isn't his.)
tasks.uz: Rover uniki bo'lishi mumkin emas. Unda Lancia bor. (= Rover uniki emasligiga ishonchim komil.)
tasks.note:
⚠ Rover va Lancia - avtomobil markalari.
⚠ 'his' - EGALIK olmoshi.

tasks.en: We use will + infinitive without to to make predictions based on what we believe or think.
tasks.uz: Ishonchimiz yoki fikrimizga asoslangan taxmin qilish uchun 'will' + 'to' siz infinitiv ishlatamiz.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'a prediction' = taxmin, bashorat.
⚠ 'to predict' = oldindan aytmoq.

tasks.en: We usually use will with I think, I expect, probably etc. I think it will rain today.
tasks.uz: 'will' ni odatda 'I think', 'I expect', 'probably' bilan ishlatamiz. Menimcha, bugun yomg'ir yog'adi.
tasks.note:
⚠ Bu so'zlar taxminni YUMShATADI.
⚠ 'probably' - 'will' dan KEYIN:
'It will probably rain.'

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures and the prompts, then make sentences with must or can't, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlar va ko'rsatmalarga qarang, so'ng must yoki can't bilan gap tuzing, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'RTTA SURAT VA JUFTLIK.

  ⚠ Har juftlikda BIRINChI so'z -
  suratdagi narsa (must be),
  IKKINChI so'z - noto'g'ri variant
  (can't be).


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  "It must be a coconut. It can't be a
   pineapple."


SURATLAR:
  1) jigarrang tukli yong'oq →
     coconut (pineapple emas)
  2) tez suzayotgan qayiq →
     speedboat (canoe emas)
  3) sariq, tekis po'stli ildizmeva →
     potato (doughnut emas)
  4) suvdan sakrayotgan sur hayvon,
     uzun tumshuqli → dolphin
     (shark emas)


⚠ 'A DOLPHIN' va 'A SHARK' FARQI:

  dolphin - sutemizuvchi, uzun tumshuq,
     do'stona
  shark - baliq, uchburchak suzgich,
     tishlari ko'rinadi

  ⚠ Hikoyada AKULA bor - shuning uchun
  bu juftlik ataylab tanlangan.


⚠ 'A SPEEDBOAT' va 'A CANOE':

  a speedboat - motorli tez qayiq
  a canoe - eshkakli tor qayiq

  ⚠ Hikoyada CANOE bor.


⚠ ARTIKL ShART:

  'It must be A coconut.'
  ⚠ Sanaladigan ot birlikda - artikl
  HAR DOIM kerak.

exercises.explanationUz:
MANTIQIY XULOSA ChIQARISh.

  ⚠ Har gapda IKKI qism bor:
  DALIL va XULOSA. Dalil xulosani
  tasdiqlaydi (must) yoki inkor qiladi
  (can't).


TAHLIL:

  1  'They look the same.' (dalil)
     → 'They MUST be twins.' (xulosa)
     ⚠ O'xshashlik egizaklikni TASDIQLAYDI.

  2  "He's got black hair." (dalil)
     → "He CAN'T be from Norway."
     ⚠ Norvegiyaliklar odatda oq-sariq
     sochli (9-betdagi xatda: 'tend to
     be tall, with fair hair').

  3  "She hasn't got one." (dalil)
     → "This car CAN'T be Susan's."
     ⚠ Mashinasi yo'q bo'lsa, bu mashina
     uniki bo'lolmaydi.

  4  'Julie is an excellent student.'
     (dalil)
     → 'She MUST study hard.'
     ⚠ A'lochilik ko'p o'qishni
     TASDIQLAYDI.

  5  "He doesn't like classical music."
     (dalil)
     → "This CD CAN'T be his."


⚠ 4-BANDGA DIQQAT:

  'She MUST STUDY hard.'
  ⚠ Bu yerda 'be' emas, ODDIY FE'L
  ('study') keladi.

  ⚠ Ya'ni 'must' taxmin ma'nosida
  faqat 'be' bilan emas, boshqa
  fe'llar bilan ham kelishi mumkin.


⚠ EGALIK ShAKLI:

  "Susan's" = Syuzanniki
  'his' = uniki
  ⚠ Bunday egalik olmoshidan keyin
  OT TAKRORLANMAYDI.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the events into the correct order, then listen and check your answers. Finally, tell the story.
exercises.instructionUz: Voqealarni to'g'ri tartibga qo'ying, so'ng tinglang va javoblaringizni tekshiring. Nihoyat, hikoyani so'zlab bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
VOQEALAR KETMA-KETLIGI.

  ⚠ Kitobda 5-band ALLAQAChON '1' deb
  belgilangan: 'Sandra and David reach
  the village of Kontu.'


TO'G'RI TARTIB:

  1  Sandra and David reach the village
     of Kontu.  (kitobda BERILGAN)
  2  Senan takes them to his hut.
  3  Senan gives them sweet potatoes to
     eat.
  4  Senan goes to the forest to begin
     his magic.
  5  Mosan curses Senan.
  6  Senan beats the water with coconut
     shells.
  7  Sharks appear.


⚠ QANDAY TEKShIRILADI:

  Komiksdagi kadrlar KETMA-KET -
  har voqeani o'z kadridan toping.

  ⚠ Mosanning la'nati 'NEXT MORNING ON
  THE SHORE' yozuvidan KEYIN - demak
  u o'rmondagi sehrdan KEYIN sodir
  bo'lgan.


⚠ HIKOYaNI SO'ZLAB BERISh:

  KETMA-KETLIK so'zlarini ishlating:
     First, ... - avval
     Then, ... - keyin
     After that, ... - shundan keyin
     Later, ... - keyinroq
     Finally, ... - nihoyat

  ⚠ Zamon: PAST SIMPLE
     reached, took, gave, went, cursed,
     beat, appeared

  ⚠ 'beat' - NOTO'G'RI fe'l:
  beat - beat - beaten (o'tgan zamon
  shakli O'ZGARMAYDI).


⚠ 'TO REACH':

  = yetib bormoq.
  ⚠ PREDLOGSIZ: 'reach the village'
  ('reach TO the village' XATO).


⚠ 'TO APPEAR':

  = paydo bo'lmoq.
  ⚠ Aksi: 'to disappear' = g'oyib bo'lmoq.

exercises.instructionEn: What do you think will happen in the next episode? Make predictions with will, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Sizningcha, keyingi qismda nima bo'ladi? 'will' bilan taxmin qiling, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
KELAJAK HAQIDA TAXMIN.

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'I think the shark WILL ATTACK them.'


⚠ QOLIP:

  I think + EGA + WILL + ODDIY FE'L

  ⚠ 'will' dan keyin 'to' YO'Q:
  'will attack' ('will to attack' XATO).


⚠ 'WILL' BILAN KELADIGAN SO'ZLAR:

  I think ... will ...
  I expect ... will ...
  ... will probably ...
  I'm sure ... will ...
  Perhaps ... will ...
  Maybe ... will ...

  ⚠ 'probably' - 'will' dan KEYIN:
  'The shark will PROBABLY attack them.'


⚠ INKOR ShAKLI:

  'I don't think the shark will attack
   them.'

  ⚠ DIQQAT: inkor BIRINChI fe'lda
  ('don't think'), ikkinchisida EMAS.
  ⚠ "I think the shark won't attack" -
  grammatik jihatdan to'g'ri, lekin
  TABIIY EMAS.


⚠ NIMA BO'LIShI MUMKIN (taxminlar):

  • Akula qayiqqa hujum qiladi
  • Senan akulani to'xtatadi
  • Mosanning la'nati ta'sir qiladi
  • Yomg'ir yog'adi
  • Sandra yoki David suvga tushib
    ketadi

  ⚠ Keyingi qism nomi 'Bad Magic'
  (46-47-betlar) - bu ham ipuchi.

⚠ Keyin ODDIY fe'l ('to' YO'Q).

sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Yo'q, u bo'lishi mumkin emas. U juda yosh.

sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ "Let's" = 'let us' - taklif.
⚠ Keyin ODDIY fe'l ('to' YO'Q).

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: You must eat only sweet potatoes and go to sleep early.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Faqat shirin kartoshka yeb, erta uxlashing kerak.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Bu yerda 'must' - HAQIQIY MAJBURIYaT.
⚠ Bir hikoyada 'must' ning IKKI ma'nosi ham bor.

⚠ "it'll" = 'it will' - kelajak haqida TAXMIN.
⚠ 25-betdagi 'Will' qutisining mavzusi.

sentencePatterns.formula: It must be [nima]. It can't be [nima].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It must be a coconut. It can't be a pineapple.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu kokos yong'og'i bo'lsa kerak. Ananas bo'lishi mumkin emas.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'must be' - 95% ishonch (ha).
⚠ "can't be" - 95% ishonch (yo'q).
⚠ "mustn't be" - XATO! U TAQIQ bildiradi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They look the same. They must be twins.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ular bir xil ko'rinadi. Ular egizak bo'lsa kerak.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Avval DALIL, keyin XULOSA.
⚠ Dalil xulosani tasdiqlasa 'must',
inkor qilsa "can't".

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I think the shark will attack them.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'will' dan keyin ODDIY fe'l ('to' YO'Q).
⚠ 'I think', 'I expect', 'probably' - taxminni
yumshatadi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I don't think the shark will attack them.
